document.abstract: A flexible lighting system has been designed to meet the needs of an active television studio. Two groups of rails provide flexibility in locating lights. Lighting is controlled from a production control console. Although the system was designed to meet the needs of a particular studio, in principle it can be adapted to a studio of any size.
